asr_text: The deeper issue is not only what appears in a feed, it is whether convenience can feel like control when the path to those choices is partly hidden. Personalized news becomes a question of place. Is the reader shaping what appears or riding a route set elsewhere? The tension is between access and visibility, not simply good and bad news.
